title: Landing work, merge review and merge queues
situations: A verified change is ready to land.
A queued pull request stops, its base changes, or required checks disagree.
The user asks which commit actually landed and whether it was reviewed.
current: Merge and close-out share one QA requirement reader. The run writer observes its lane commit at start when available, without replacing verified identity. The latest completed pass on an effective item requirement authorizes merge and close-out without comparing commits; configuration, target, subject proof and review refusals still block. Required queue CI tests the final commit. Source-observed; not yet verified-live.
questions: Audit merge candidate review, human review and queue CI reuse as distinct contracts; current map mentions approvals/QA but does not trace this complete landing family.
